none.title: No changes
none.body: The spec is the same as the current one. There's nothing to apply.

parse.expectedKey: Expected a property name in double quotes
parse.expectedColon: Expected a colon after the property name
parse.expectedCommaOrEnd: Expected a comma or the closing bracket
parse.badEscape: That is not a valid escape in a string
parse.controlChar: A string can't hold a line break or a control character. Write it as an escape, like \n
parse.unterminated: A string is missing its closing quote
parse.badNumber: That is not a valid number
parse.notObject: The spec must be an object
parse.afterEnd: Unexpected content after the end of the spec
parse.unsafeInteger: {{path}} is {{value}}, a whole number too large to edit here without changing it. Use a smaller number.
parse.notFinite: {{path}} is not a number a service spec can hold
parse.tooDeep: The spec is nested too deeply
parse.tooBig: The spec expands to too many values
parse.complexKey: A key must be a plain name, not a list or a map

editor.name: Service spec, {{format}}
editor.helper: The full service spec as Docker stores it. Hidden values show as <hidden>. They stay as they are unless you replace them.
editor.comments: Comments are dropped if you switch to JSON.

error.fix: Fix the spec before you review changes.

page.title: Edit {{name}}
page.description: Change its settings, review the difference, then apply.
page.invalid: Fix the spec before you review changes.

stackOwned.heading: {{name}} is managed by stack {{stack}}
stackOwned.body: Change its settings through the stack so the next deploy doesn't overwrite them.

review.title: Review changes
review.body: Check what will change on {{name}}, then apply.
review.refusal: This service uses settings that need Admin: {{list}}. Ask an administrator to apply it.
review.hiddenOnly: The changes are to values that are hidden from you, so they aren't listed.

newObjects.title: New objects
newObjects.intro: These don't exist yet. They're created first, then the service.
newObjects.networkNote: Created as an attachable overlay network.
newObjects.reason: Add a value for {{count}} secrets and configs first.

done.title: Update complete
done.body_one: {{name}} is running {{count}} task on the new settings.
done.body_other: {{name}} is running {{count}} tasks on the new settings.

cleanup.removed: Couldn't update {{name}}. {{reason}} The {{count}} objects created for this change were removed.
cleanup.notRemoved: Couldn't update {{name}}. {{reason}} TierPlan couldn't remove {{list}}. Remove them under Networks, Secrets or Configs.
cleanup.createRemoved: Couldn't create {{name}}. {{reason}} The {{count}} objects created for this change were removed.
cleanup.createNotRemoved: Couldn't create {{name}}. {{reason}} TierPlan couldn't remove {{list}}. Remove them under Networks, Secrets or Configs.

refusal.service_changed: This service was changed by someone else while you were editing. Reload it, then make your changes again.
refusal.stack_owned: This service is managed by a stack, so it can't be edited here. Change it through the stack.
refusal.spec_invalid_bare: The spec can't be read as a service spec.
refusal.name_immutable: A service's name can't change. Create a new service instead.
refusal.stack_label_reserved: Labels starting with com.docker.stack. are reserved.
refusal.placeholder_unmatched: A hidden value in the spec has nothing behind it: {{path}} isn't in the service. Type its value or remove it.
refusal.placeholder_reserved: <hidden> is what TierPlan shows for a value it withholds, so it can't be a value. Type the real value or remove it.
refusal.objects_missing: The spec names objects that don't exist: {{list}}. Create them first, then review again.
refusal.too_many_objects: One change can create at most 16 objects.
refusal.image_required: Enter an image like nginx:1.27 or ghcr.io/acme/app:latest.

create.title: Create service
create.description: Set up a service Swarm runs for you. Review it before anything is created.

review.title: Review {{name}}
review.body: Check the service TierPlan will create, then create it.
